summary: A session-authenticated, SSRF-hardened server-side proxy/cache that serves an entry-date rate proposal (FX via Frankfurter, gold via NBP+Frankfurter) for a fixed base unit, and the read-only symbol table the account form's unit picker and this endpoint share.

read.role: single-account entry screen showing the proposal and its provenance
sweep screen fetching a fresh proposal per row on Confirm
rate/money typography, chip and button conventions, and loading/error-state defaults for the entry and sweep screens, plus the shell that hosts the sweep as a global action

responseShape200.value: { rate, base, quote, asOf, source, cached }

statusCodes.badRequest: 400 (unrecognised param, symbol not in table, malformed/future/pre-floor date, quote not a kind:currency symbol-table row)

identityShortCircuit.value: symbol == quote returns 200, rate: "1", asOf = requested date, source: "identity", cached: false, no outbound request

symbolRegex.value: ^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,15}$, and must also be present in the symbol table

dateFloors.value: gold: 2013-01-02; other symbols: the provider's own history start; enforced per-symbol, not a single global floor

egressHardening.value: HTTPS only with cert verification, redirects disabled, 5s connect+read timeout, response size cap, provider hosts/URL templates are server-side constants

cacheTtl.value: past dates cached indefinitely; today's date cached 1 hour then refetched

rateLimitDefault.value: 120 requests/hour per user, independent of the login limiter (operator config)

circuitBreaker.value: opens after 5 consecutive provider failures, serves 204 for a 5-minute cool-off (operator config)

goldUnitConversion.value: XAU-g takes NBP's gram figure directly; XAU-ozt = gram figure * 31.1034768, composed at full precision and rounded once at the end

goldRangeQuery.value: GET /api/cenyzlota/{date-14d}/{date}, taking the last entry on or before date; empty result in the 14-day window means 204; NBP caps a range at 93 days

goldFxLegDate.value: the PLN->quote FX leg is fetched at the asOf date, not the requested date

goldSourceLabel.value: "nbp+frankfurter" when a second leg is used, "nbp" when quote is PLN

metalSymbolNamingRule.value: <ISO 4217 metal code>-<unit>, unit ozt or g

currencySymbolSource.value: seeded from Frankfurter's own currency list, all with lookup: true

fixtures: a stubbed Frankfurter and NBP provider (success, empty-window, and failure responses) so tests never hit the live services
a stubbed provider returning 302 toward an internal address, to assert SSRF/redirect hardening
a stubbed provider that hangs, to assert the timeout path returns 204 within the configured window
the seeded symbol table (eight metal rows plus the Frankfurter currency list) as a fixture, since one acceptance criterion sweeps every returned symbol against /api/rates
focus: the accepted-query-parameter test must enumerate the exact set {symbol, date, quote} and reject anything extra, not just accept the documented three
SSRF hardening needs adversarial symbol values (path traversal, a URL, a regex-matching-but-untabled symbol) actually asserted against zero outbound calls, not just a 400 status
the gold two-leg composition must assert the FX leg is fetched at asOf, not the requested date — needs a stub where the two dates would produce different rates
the circuit breaker and rate limiter are operator-config defaults; tests assert behaviour at whatever value is configured, not a hardcoded count
provider API key must never appear in a log line, response body, or error message — requires inspecting actual output, not just the response status
